target_customer: Households that buy groceries and cook at home, paying for a kitchen device and a subscription
problem: One person in a household has to remember what food is running low, what needs using up and what to cook, because the information is scattered across cupboards, receipts and recipes.
business_model: Consumer hardware preorder ($99 device) plus subscription (Food Club, $9.99 per month after three months)
product_category: Consumer smart kitchen assistant and agentic grocery shopping

founders.name: Matt Taylor
education: George Washington University, MS and BS Electrical Engineering

founders.name: Zach Slaughter
founders.background_notes: Per YC company page; listed as Founder/COO.

competitors.name: Grocery AI (Pocket Labs)
competitors.what: iOS app for pantry inventory, expiry alerts, smart lists and receipt scanning

competitors.name: Gravitas Kitchen
competitors.what: App that turns typed or dictated pantry contents into inventory with a cart handoff to Kroger and Ralphs

competitors.name: Uber Eats agentic grocery shopping
competitors.what: Agentic AI layered into grocery ordering

competitors.name: Instacart Clementine
competitors.what: AI assistant that simplifies grocery shopping

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs a camera and microphone device plus app, receipt and food recognition and an ordering agent. Standard hardware and ML integration for a two person team, with supply chain risk.

defensibility.rationale: Household inventory history could create some lock in, but several apps and large grocery platforms offer similar tracking and agent ordering.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Instacart and Uber Eats were already shipping agentic grocery assistants in 2026; no outcome yet for Trepo.

market_need_then: Households carry a mental load of tracking food and waste. The company sells a $99 preorder device with the pitch that you do not have to keep it all in your head. No independent demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses hellotrepo.com as the main site; trepo.ai appears as a contact domain. Dates unknown.

identity.visual_style: consumer product site with device preorder and calm household framing
identity.voice_and_tone: reassuring and privacy minded, tagline: You don't have to keep it all in your head.

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage with no press, community or merch found; only a clear tagline and privacy message on the site.

outcome_analysis: Trepo is an active Fall 2026 YC company with two founders, a $99 preorder kitchen device and no disclosed funding. No outcome exists yet. The founders have hardware and brand marketing backgrounds, while Instacart and Uber Eats were already shipping agentic grocery tools in 2026.
